content: Within SoAd_MainFunction() and after successfully performing the open actions, SoAd shall change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE in case of a UDP socket and either SoAdSocketUdpListenOnly is set to TRUE or a remote address is set by a value that does not contain any wildcards.
